messages:
Ruth Chen: quick sync — I'm seeing inconsistent microexamples across SDK snippets: some use `user_prompt`, others use `prompt`, and a few still say `queryId`. We should settle on one term and update the glossary + migration guide.
Maya Patel: ugh yeah saw that in the node sdk PR, also the python examples differ on the param order.
Eli Thompson: can we pick stable names that map to the API payload? my vote: `prompt` (required), `metadata` (optional), `client_request_id` (snake_case) — keeps things explicit for logging.
Alex Gomez: prefer `request_id` over `client_request_id` — shorter and matches telemetry fields we already send.
Maya Patel: +1 to `request_id`. other libs already surface `requestId` in JS so normalize to `request_id` in docs but note client casing differences in SDK snippets.
Ruth Chen: action items: 1) pick canonical doc names, 2) add glossary entries for each param, 3) add a small migration note for SDKs. I'll open a doc PR with changes.
Eli Thompson: please include a tiny snippet showing recommended casing per language, e.g.
```
# Python
response = client.generate(prompt="hi", request_id="abc-123")

// Node
const res = await client.generate({ prompt: "hi", requestId: "abc-123" })
```
Maya Patel: and add a short note: "Docs use snake_case as canonical names; SDKs show idiomatic casing per language." Keeps search consistent. :+1:
Ruth Chen: drafting PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 (WIP) — will replace occurrences of `user_prompt` and `queryId`.
Alex Gomez: tiny nit — for glossary entry, add `request_id (doc canonical) — unique id supplied by client for idempotency/observability` and link to telemetry page.
docs-bot: Reminder: Docs PR template requires "migration notes" section for breaking changes.
Maya Patel: good call. add a migration checklist item: replace `queryId` -> `request_id` in examples, add mapping table for old->new keys.
Eli Thompson: also check the example playbooks that reference `user_prompt` in the quickstarts — they get copied into onboarding emails.
Ruth Chen: will sweep quickstarts and SDK snippets. ETA: tomorrow EOD for PR update.
Alex Gomez: I'll review after you push. If no objections, we should mark the glossary entry as canonical and create a small changelog entry.
Maya Patel: LGTM, add me as reviewer on the PR.
Ruth Chen: added @Maya, @Alex, @Eli. pushing patches now. thanks all. :sparkles:
Alex Gomez: thanks!
Maya Patel: :shipit:
Eli Thompson: :thumbsup:
